about_the_game:
Zero Gravity Heroes: Reclaim the Shattered Cosmos

The universe is counting on you!

The Universal Defense Grid has collapsed, scattering fragments of an ancient space map across 30 perilous sectors. As an Elite Quantum Pilot, you must master three intense microgames to restore cosmic balance before time runs out!

Your Mission

🛸 Precision Landing – Navigate asteroid fields and security tunnels in a high-stakes lunar lander challenge. Control thrusters, dodge hazards, and deactivate defensive grids to secure landing zones.
⚡ Ground Operations – Strap into your jetpack, scavenge fuel, and outmaneuver enemy patrols to power your escape rocket. One wrong move spells disaster!
🔫 Orbital Defense – Battle rogue guardians in tactical space combat. Outgun corrupted defense systems guarding each sector.

Key Features

✅ 3 Games in 1! - Lunar Lander. Jetpack Platformer. Space Shooter. All in one epic level loop.
✅ 30 Handcrafted Levels + Secret Bonus Game - Collect hidden puzzle pieces across stages to unlock an ancient space map and reveal a final extra game.
✅ Retro Gameplay, Modern Polish - Fast arcade action, smooth controls, and stylized visuals built for today’s players.

⚠️ The universe’s stability hangs by a thread. Will you rise as a hero—or let chaos reign?
